verdict.rationale: Wave documents invoice status tracking (viewed/due/paid), overdue reminders, and general accounting reports with month/year comparisons, and it explicitly ties invoicing data to accounting for organization — implying per-customer balance tracking exists. However, no evidence explicitly names an AR aging report or a dedicated per-customer balance/statement feature. Missing for 10: explicit aging report documentation, explicit per-customer balance/statement view, independent corroboration of AR reporting depth.
